mechanism: Combines the p=2 DirectContinuous routing, the widened DirectContinuous guard and the p ≤ 8 DirectSmall predicate. All three branches retain their unconditional spec theorems; no new proof obligation is introduced.
hypothesis: Composite direct-routing candidate: p=2 rows and 3<=p<=8 rows both leave Cross/Packed10.
proof: No new proof obligation: each edited `if` keeps both branches and their existing spec theorems; only the decidable predicate changes.
